purpose: Data construction only: teacher-native calibration sessions on the calibration-split families (calibration_v1), regenerated with the asynchronous runner after the battery session's round-synchronous runner was stopped before this unit to protect its completed measurements from the hard stop.

sampling.generate: teacher official preset T0.6/top_p0.95/top_k20/min_p0, one seeded request per turn

session_limit_note: 16384 tokens end to end is a DATA-CONSTRUCTION bound for calibration sessions, recorded per session as length_limited; it is never applied to a measurement

hardware.why: generation is bounded by the 16384-token data-construction limit, which an L40S holds; no measurement runs here, so the teacher's 262144 context is not needed
